mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, sortOrder, DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM processstep ORDER BY sortOrder ASC, createdAt ASC
SELECT id, title, description, sortOrder, DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM processstep WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO processstep (id, title, description, sortOrder, createdAt, updatedAt) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE processstep SET title=#{title}, description=#{description}, updatedAt=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE processstep SET sortOrder=#{sortOrder}, updatedAt=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
